description: Source code implementing a menu box interface using ncurses, including functions for rendering menu items, scroll indicators, buttons, and handling user input for menu navigation.

methods.name: do_print_item
methods.description: Prints a menu item with highlighting and hotkey indicator.

methods.name: print_arrows
methods.description: Displays scroll up/down indicators based on current scroll position.

methods.name: print_buttons
methods.description: Displays control buttons at the bottom of the menu window.

methods.name: do_scroll
methods.description: Scrolls the menu window up or down by a specified number of lines.

methods.name: dialog_menu
methods.description: Main function to display a menu dialog, handle user input, and return selected option.
